The Alchemists are puppets of Diamantes.
We, too, are now hunted here.

MsgJp:
幸いにもテオドールの塔には制御杭が
仕込まれているから、錬魔達はこの周囲へ
入れないがな
MsgEn: Fortunately, Theodor's tower has control stakes embedded in it, so the magic practitioners cannot enter this vicinity.

MsgJp:
術杭と錬成した魔物を、我々は錬魔と呼ぶ
騎士団より便利に仕える兵として
ディアマンテスらが生み出した哀れな半生命だ
MsgEn:
We call the monsters created by Diamantes through alchemy "Alchemized".
They are pitiful semi-life forms created to serve the knight order conveniently.

MsgJp:
あやつがそんな研究をしたのも
溶命炉を悪しきことに使ったのも
全てあの男一人が始めたことなのか――
MsgEn: Is it all because of that man, who conducted such research, who also used the Furnace for evil purposes?

MsgJp:
地上か――
戻れるなら戻りたいものだ
MsgEn:
On the ground, perhaps--
If I could go back, I would want to return.

MsgJp:
だが、異なる時を歩み過ぎた我々に
果たして行き場はあるのだろうか
MsgEn: However, for us who have walked through different times, Is there really a place to go?
Yes, may I help you with something?

MsgJp:
王宮層の《メルガン・アルケミデア》は
錬金術研究の高等研究室だ
MsgEn: The upper level of the royal palace is the advanced laboratory of Alchemized research, Mergan Alchemium.

MsgJp:
ディアマンテス派の術師の中には
まだそこで錬魔研究をしている者も
いるようだ
MsgEn: Among the practitioners of the Diamantes faction, there still seem to be those who are conducting alchemy research there.

MsgJp:
何の研究をしているかは不明だが
嫌な予感がする――
MsgEn: I have no idea what research they are conducting, but I have a bad feeling about it.

MsgJp:
地上の水、動物、人、全てが恋しい
貴方達を見ると不思議なことに
そういう想いが湧いてきます
MsgEn:
I miss the water on the surface, the animals, and the people.
When I see all of you, strangely enough such feelings well up within me.

MsgJp: 地上の品があれば、喜んで引きとりましょう
MsgEn: If there are earthly goods, I will gladly accept them.

MsgJp: 役に立ちそうなものはありましたか？
品物の取引であれば応じましょう
MsgEn: Let's consider a mere transaction for the goods.

MsgJp:
一つご忠告をしておきましょう
我らの元へ来る時は、可能なかぎり
拠点の礎を利用してください
MsgEn: Let me give you one important piece of advice: When you come to our place, please make use of the Portcrystals, which are the keystones of our Halls, as much as possible.

MsgJp:
《宮殿前広場》には、グリフィンアルケミーなどの
錬魔以外にも、メルガンの高等技師が機兵を
操っていることもあるのです
MsgEn: In the "Palace Plaza," there are not only alchemized Griffins, but also advanced Mergan engineers who control mechanical soldiers.

MsgJp:
――ああ、我々も覚者であったなら
この礎で懐かしき地へ戻ることが
できるのに――
MsgEn: - Sigh... If only we were Arisen, we could return to that nostalgic land with this Portcrystal...

MsgJp:
ええ、あなたとの取引であれば
いついかなる時でも応じましょう
それが助力となるのであれば――
MsgEn: Yes, if it's a mere transaction with you, I will accommodate it at any time, as long as it helps.

MsgJp:
地上のもの全てを恋しく思ってきました
たとえ我々がそれらを二度と見ることが無くとも
この世から失うわけにはゆきません
MsgEn:
I have longingly yearned for everything on the surface.
Even if we never see them again, we cannot lose it from this world.

MsgJp:
忘れないでください
メルゴダの民も、レスタニアの力と
なりたがっていたと
MsgEn:
Please do not forget;
The people of Mergoda, also wished to possess the power of Lestania

MsgJp:
――この世は、全てをあなたに
背負わせることになってしまいましたね
MsgEn: -This world has ended up burdening you with everything, hasn't it?

MsgJp:
うむ――
かつては時を惜しんで術の探究に励んだ
ものだが、今やただ耐えて過ごすばかり
MsgEn:
Indeed――
Once, I earnestly pursued the study of techniques, cherishing every moment.
But now, I merely endure and pass the time.

MsgJp: 我らはこれで良いのだろうか

覚者とは、竜とは何なのだろう
この世界の理、それがどういうものであるのか
あの男には見えていたのだろうか
MsgEn:
What is an Arisen, and what is a dragon? 
The order of this world, what exactly is it? 
Could that man see it?

MsgJp:
森の民エルフ――
竜力増幅のため、ゴルゴランに捧げられた
莫大な数、莫大な量の命――
MsgEn:
Elf of the Forest ――
For the amplification of Dragon Force, 
Countless lives, an immense quantity,
Offered to Golgorran ――

MsgJp: 溶命炉は、まさしく禁忌の技であったのだ
MsgEn: The Furnace of Life Dissolution was truly a forbidden technique.

MsgJp:
私にご用かな
友への呼びかけであれば、力添えをしよう
MsgEn: If it is a call to a friend, I will offer my assistance.

MsgJp:
護政区の礎からここに至るまでに
半壊した建物があっただろう
MsgEn: There must have been partially destroyed buildings along the path from the Imperial Quarter's Portcrystal to here.

MsgJp:
あの奥には《錬金研究室》があってな
合成用や研究用に選抜された魔物が
これまでに数回、暴走していたことがある
MsgEn:
Behind that is the Alchemy Laboratory. 
Enemies selected for synthesis and research have gone out of control several times in the past.

MsgJp:
魔物を意のままに制御しようなど
もともと手を出してよい研究ではなかったのだ
MsgEn: It was never a permissible field of study to control enemies as one pleases.

MsgJp:
友へ呼びかけたいというのなら
私に任せてくれ
せめて最後まで力になりたいのだ
MsgEn:
If you want to call out to a friend, leave it to me.
I want to at least be of help until the end.

MsgJp:
――ずっと後悔してきた
今ばかりは後悔の無い選択をしたい
MsgEn:
I have been regretting things for a long time.
Now, I just want to make a choice without regrets.

MsgJp:
覚者、竜、理――
どれだけ研究を重ねても
私にはその存在に対し、理解が及ばなかった
MsgEn:
Arisen, Dragon, Order――
No matter how much research I conducted, I could not comprehend the existence of the Arisen

MsgJp:
己の命が、己の身体が滅んでも
この世の理というものは不変であると
そう信じてきたのだ――
MsgEn: Even if my life, even if my body were to be destroyed, I have believed that the order of this world remains unchanged-

MsgJp:
だからこそあれほどまでに
研究に打ち込めたのだろうな
MsgEn: That's why I was able to immerse myself so much in my research.

MsgJp:
それにしても、よくこんなに
きれいな洞窟を見つけられたものね
休息の場を早々に確保できたのは恵まれているわ
MsgEn:
Anyway, it's amazing that we were able to find such a beautiful cave. 
We are fortunate to have secured a resting place so quickly.

MsgJp:
私のところに来るってことは
自分を万全の状態に整えたいってことね
良い心がけだわ
MsgEn:
The fact that you come to me means that you want to prepare yourself to the best possible condition.
That's a good attitude.

MsgJp:
覚者たる者、常に万全の体調を維持すべきね
そのための休息も務めのうちと思って
自分の状態を冷静に把握して
MsgEn:
As an Arisen, one should always maintain optimal physical condition. 
Rest and recuperation should be considered part of our duty. 
It is important to calmly assess one's own state.

MsgJp:
体は全ての資本よ
少しでも違和感を感じたら
無理せず休んだ方がいい結果が出る
MsgEn:
Your body is your most valuable asset. 
If you ever feel any discomfort, it's better to take a break without pushing yourself. 
Better results will follow.

MsgJp:
最後に頼れるのは自分の体だけ
後悔したくなければ、体調には常に気を配りなさい
MsgEn:
In the end, the only one you can rely on is your own body. 
If you want to avoid regrets, always be mindful of your physical condition.

MsgJp:
休息も務めのうちよ
臨時の拠点だけど、それなりの寝床は用意したわ
<VAL PRICE_INN>かかるけど、泊まっていく？
MsgEn:
Rest is also part of the duty.
It's a temporary base, but I've prepared decent sleeping quarters.
It will cost <VAL PRICE_INN>, would you like to stay?

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》が必要？
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>かかるけど、いい？
MsgEn:
Is "Treat Weakness" required? 
It costs <VAL PRICE_WEAK>, is that acceptable?

MsgJp:
ん？　《弱化》していないようね
健康で何よりだわ
MsgEn:
Hmm? It seems you haven't weakened, huh?
Being healthy is the most important thing after all.

MsgJp:
休息も務めのうちよ
ちょうど寝床が空いているから
好きに休んでいくといいわ
MsgEn:
Rest is also part of the job, you know. 
Since the bed is empty right now, feel free to take a rest as you like.

MsgJp: ――なんだ、欲しいものでもあるのか
MsgEn: ――What is it, is there something you want?

MsgJp:
おい、回復薬とランタンの火種は
多めに持っとけよ
MsgEn: Hey, make sure to bring plenty of healing potions and a lantern's fire source.

MsgJp:
わざわざこんなところまで
運んできてやってんだ――無いと困るだろうが
MsgEn:
I went to all the trouble to bring it here, you know. 
You'd better not be without it.

MsgJp:
いいか、普段見ねぇものを見ても慌てるんじゃねぇ
慌てるとロクなことがねぇからな
MsgEn:
Listen, don't panic when you see things you don't usually see. 
Panicking won't do you any good.

MsgJp:
だからと言って、自分の知っているものに当てはめて
ナメてかかっても痛い目を見る――
MsgEn: But don't get too cocky and assume that what you know applies to everything; you might still run into trouble.

MsgJp:
つまり、大切なのは平常心だ
落ち着いてさえいれば何とかなるからよ
MsgEn: So, what matters most is to keep a calm mind. As long as you remain composed, you can handle anything.

MsgJp:
洞窟の中で過ごすっていうのも
悪くはねぇもんだな
MsgEn: Living within the confines of a cave is not such a dire fate, I must say.

MsgJp:
はい――
ご友人への呼びかけなら、自分がお手伝いします
MsgEn:
Yes--

If it's a call for a friend, I'll help you.

MsgJp:
この地の動植物は――
変わったものが多いですね――
MsgEn: The animals and plants of this land, there are many peculiar ones.

MsgJp:
時間があれば図鑑でも作って
レスタニアの子供たちに見せたいものです――
MsgEn: If you have time, please create an encyclopedia that I would like to show to the children of Lestania.

MsgJp:
自分は見た目がコレですから――
動物や子供はまず寄ってこないんです――
寄ってくるのはモンスターだけですね――
MsgEn:
Since I look like this--
Animals and children won't come near me--
Only monsters approach me--

MsgJp:
時間があれば、この島の植物を摘んで
少し持って帰ろうと思っています――
MsgEn: If you have the time, I'm thinking of picking some plants from this island and bringing them back with me.

MsgJp:
この地のものは
色合いの美しいものが多いですから――
MsgEn: The things of this land are often beautifully colored, so...

MsgJp:
何か言いたそうだな
――いや、言ってくれ
話をしよう
MsgEn:
It seems like you want to say something.
No, go ahead and say it.
Let's talk.

MsgJp:
白衛騎士団はいつも隊として行動するせいか
個人の力を見くびられがちだと感じている
MsgEn: The White Knight Order always acts as a team, which often leads to underestimation of individual abilities.

MsgJp:
だが、心身ともに鍛練を積んだ精鋭一人一人が
結束してさらに力を発揮する――
それが騎士団なのだ
甘く見てもらっては困る
MsgEn:
However, each elite individual in the Knight Order, who has trained both their mind and body, comes together and unleashes even greater power.
That is what the Knight Order is.
It would be troubling if you were to underestimate us.

MsgJp:
今回の任務は
覚者と騎士団員の混合編成だと聞いていたが
実際はほとんどが覚者か
MsgEn: The mission this time was supposed to be a mixed formation of Arisen and Knight members, but in reality, almost all of them are Arisen.

MsgJp:
適正というものがあってのことなのだろうが
俺としてはもう少し騎士団員がいた方が
何かと動きやすかったな――
MsgEn: I suppose there is something to be said for having the appropriate personnel, but personally, I would have found it easier to have a few more Knights around.

MsgJp:
だが――裏を返せば、俺は覚者に劣らぬ働きを
期待されているということ
白衛騎士団の働き、見てろよ
MsgEn:
However, on the other hand, it means that I am expected to work just as well as an Arisen. 
Watch the labor of the White Knight Order.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様は覚者への信頼が厚いようだが――
白衛騎士団とてその信に足るということ
証明してみせる
MsgEn:
Master Joseph seems to have great trust in the Arisen...
Even the White Knight Order must prove themselves worthy of that trust.
I will show you the proof.
Foreigner, do you have some business with me?

MsgJp:
何か言いたいことがあるなら
それに見合った力を示してもらおう
それがダナのやり方だ
MsgEn:
If you have something to say, show me the corresponding strength for it.
That's Dana's way.

MsgJp:
エリア情報が欲しければ
ラザネイルに聞いてみるがいい
MsgEn: If you want Area Information, you should ask Razanailt.

MsgJp:
俺は戦士として村を空けることもある
その間も滞りなく村を管理しているのが女房だ
この辺りについては誰よりも詳しい
MsgEn:
As a soldier, I sometimes have to leave the village. 
During that time, my wife manages the village smoothly. 
She is more knowledgeable about this area than anyone else.

MsgJp:
――お前たちは別の大陸から来た
別の竜の覚者だと言ったな
MsgEn: You came from a different continent, and claimed to be a different Dragon's Arisen.

MsgJp:
その竜の元を離れても
竜力の恩恵を受けられるものなのか――？
MsgEn: Even if one were to separate from the source of that dragon's power, is it still possible to receive the benefits of Dragon Force?

MsgJp:
数々の無礼を許してくれ
もっとも、その原因の大部分はガルドリンの
口の悪さにある
MsgEn:
Please forgive me for numerous rudenesses.
However, the main cause of them lies in Gurdolin's foul mouth.

MsgJp:
あれさえなければ我らは似たもの同士かも
しれない
MsgEn: If not for that, we might be kindred spirits.

MsgJp:
我々を出会った頃の我々とは思うな
どんな敵が相手でも躊躇はしない
MsgEn:
Do not think of us as the same as when we first met.
We will not hesitate against any enemy.

MsgJp:
客人の助力には感謝しているが
ここは我らの世界だからな
MsgEn: I appreciate the assistance of the guests, but this is our world, you know.

MsgJp:
空気の、匂いの変化がわかるか？
浄化は確実に進んでいるのだ
MsgEn:
Can you sense the change in the air and the scent?
The purification is progressing nicely.

MsgJp:
ダナのことかい？
そんならあたしが話を聞こうじゃないか
MsgEn:
Is it about Dana?
If so, then why don't I listen to the story?

MsgJp:
ここ、ダナでは戦うこと、力強いことが
何よりも大切なのさ
ずっと昔から、そうやって村を支えてきてるんだ
MsgEn:
Is it about Dana?
If so, then why don't I listen to the story?

MsgJp:
戦士たちが強くあることで、この村は
他の部族からも一目置かれてるんだよ
MsgEn: Because the warriors are strong, this village is respected by other tribes.

MsgJp:
あたしは武器持って戦いには出ないけど
戦士たちの世話をすることで戦ってるのさ
MsgEn: I don't wield weapons or join in battle, but I fight by taking care of the soldiers.

MsgJp:
異国の覚者がどれほどのものか知らないけど
とりあえず、エリアマスターとして
自己紹介といこうかね
MsgEn: I don't know how powerful the foreign Arisen is, but for now, as an Area Master, let me introduce myself.

MsgJp:
あたしはラザネイル
ファーラナ平原一帯を預かるエリアマスターさ
MsgEn: I am Razanailt, the Area Master responsible for the entire Farana Plains.

MsgJp:
――ダンナのピサルはダナの族長であり
戦士たちの長でもあって忙しいからね
エリアのことはあたしが仕切ってるのさ
MsgEn:
My husband Pisarr is the chieftain of the Dana tribe and also the leader of the warriors, so he's busy. 
As for the area, I'm the one in charge.

MsgJp:
そう、ダナは戦士の村――
うちの戦士たちの働きで
このファーラナ平原はフィンダムの中じゃ
侵食魔の活動を抑えられてる方だよ
MsgEn:
Yes, Dana is the warrior village.
Thanks to the efforts of our soldiers, the Farana Plains in Phindym is one of the areas with less infected activity.

MsgJp:
強くあることで、人々を
そして大地を守ることができるのさ
大切なものと生き残るために
何よりも大切にすべきは強さってこと――
MsgEn:
By being strong, we can protect the people and so, the land as well.
To survive and protect what is important above all else, strength is what should be cherished —

MsgJp:
アンタもこの村で何か言いたいことがあれば
強さを示すんだね
MsgEn: If you have something to say in this village, then show your strength, okay?

MsgJp:
そうだ、コレ持っていきな！
何かの足しにはなるはずだよ
MsgEn:
That's right, bring this along!
It should be a useful addition to something.

MsgJp:
あんたも覚者なら竜のために戦うのが仕事だろ
これ、持っていきな！
気合入れて戦うんだよ！
MsgEn:
If you're also an Arisen, then it's your job to fight for the sake of the dragon, right? 
Take this with you! Fight with all your might!

MsgJp:
そうだ、これをあんたに渡そうと思って――
ほら、いつも力を貸してもらってるからね！
たまにはお礼しとかないと女がすたるってものよ
MsgEn:
Yes, I thought I'd give this to you.
You know, because you always lend me your strength!
If I don't thank you once in a while, a woman will lose her charm, you know!

MsgJp:
ふぅ――
侵食のせいでピリピリしてるってのに
さらに問題が起きるなんてね
MsgEn:
Phew... 
To think that on top of the irritation caused by the Corruption, even more problems would arise.

MsgJp:
ああ、最近地鳴りがひどいだろ？
タラスクが現れる前触れなんじゃないかって
皆心配してるのさ
MsgEn:
Oh, recently the ground shaking has been really bad, huh?
Everyone is worried that it might be a sign of the Tarasque appearing.

MsgJp:
地鳴りに神経質になってるのは人間だけじゃないよ
特に小さい魔物なんかはすっかり怯えちまって
あちこちに見張りを立ててるみたいだ
MsgEn:
It's not just humans who get nervous
about earthquakes, you know.
Small enemies seem to be completely terrified.
It looks like they have set up guards everywhere.

MsgJp:
例えば《<SPOT 918>》とかね――
あんたも気を付けときな
小物とはいえ、突然襲いかかってこられたら
ケガするかもしれないんだからね
MsgEn:
For example, <SPOT 918>, you know...
Hear, you should be careful too.
Even though they're small,
if they suddenly attack, you might get injured.

MsgJp:
え？　地鳴りについて、かい？
相変わらずさ――
MsgEn:
What's that?
About the earthquake, huh?
It's as usual...

MsgJp:
せめて、昔の記録でも漁れば
この地鳴りの正体についてわかりそうなものだけど
あいにく、昔の本がある遺跡は
獣だらけになっちまってね
MsgEn:
At least, if we could search through old records,
we might be able to understand the true nature
of this earth-shaking phenomenon.
Unfortunately, the ancient ruins where old books
are said to exist have been overrun by animals.

MsgJp:
ああ、そうそう、本といえば――
あんたに頼みごとをしたいって子がいるんだ
MsgEn:
Oh, speaking of books...
There's a child who'd like to ask you for a favor.

MsgJp:
話を聞きにいってくれるなら
連絡しとくからさ、まずはあたしに話しかけてよ
MsgEn:
If you're willing to listen,
I can inform you, so first talk to me.

MsgJp:
いいところに来たね
あんたに伝えたいことがあったんだよ
MsgEn:
You've come to a good place,
there's something I want to tell you.

MsgJp:
実は、今まで封鎖してた《<STG 860>》を
開放することにしたのさ
MsgEn:
Actually, I have decided to unblock
the <STG 860>
that had been blocked until now.

MsgJp:
あそこにも埃っぽい過去の文献がこれでもかと
しまいこんであるからね――
中を調べれば、何かわかるんじゃないかと思うんだ
MsgEn:
Because there, too, are dusty old documents
piled up as far as the eye can see...
I think if we were to investigate inside,
we might find something.

MsgJp:
でね、よかったらあんたにも
調査に行ってもらえないかと思ってさ
MsgEn:
Hey, if you're up for it, I was thinking
maybe you could go on a survey too.

MsgJp:
ウチの若いのだけじゃ、貴重な手がかりがあっても
魔物を狩るのに必死になっちまって
見逃すかもしれないからね――
MsgEn:
It's because if it's just our young ones,
even if we have valuable clues,
they might become desperate in hunting down
the enemies, and they might overlook them.

MsgJp:
もう自由に入れるようになってるから
気が向いたら頼むよ
MsgEn:
Now you can enter freely,
so feel free to ask whenever you feel like it.

MsgJp:
そうそう――ひとつ、面白い話があるよ
聞いてくかい？
MsgEn:
Oh, by the way... I have an interesting story.
Would you like to hear it?

MsgJp:
遺跡にあった本を持ち帰って調べたら
東の水路は《マグサス古水路》に
繋がってることがわかったんだよ
MsgEn:
When I brought back the book I found
in the ruins and examined it, I discovered
that the eastern waterway connects
to the Magusas Ancient Canal.

MsgJp:
《マグサス古水路》は水路と墓場が一緒になった
変わった施設でね――その昔、タラスクと
死闘を繰り広げた古将マグサスが眠っているのさ
MsgEn:
The Watercourse is a peculiar facility where
a watercourse and a graveyard have merged. 
From ancient times, the renowned General Magusas
who fiercely battled the Tarasque, lies asleep within.

MsgJp:
何せ、ダナの誇る英雄が眠ってるんだ――
きっとタラスク撃退のための、何らかの
手がかりが遺されてるに違いないよ
MsgEn:
Well, because Dana's proud hero is sleeping...
There must surely be some kind of clue
left behind for repelling the Tarasque.

MsgJp:
今、《マグサス古水路》に向かうための橋を
大急ぎで復旧しているところさ
橋ができたら、きっとあんたも便利になるよ！
MsgEn:
Right now, they're rushing to quickly restore
the bridge that leads to the Magusas Watercourse.
Once the bridge is complete, it will surely
become more convenient for you too!

MsgJp:
まぁ、《<SPOT 920>》辺りに魔物が出てきて
何度も工事が止まっちまってるんだけどね――
MsgEn:
Well, it seems that monsters have been appearing
around <SPOT 920>, causing the construction
to stop multiple times...

MsgJp:
あんた、よかったらあの辺りを探索して
出る魔物を片っ端からぶん殴ってくれないかい？
一応お礼もするからさ
引き受けてくれるんなら、もう一度声かけておくれよ
MsgEn:
Hey, if you're up for it, how about exploring
around that area and beating up enemies
one after another? I'll give you a reward for it,
so if you're willing to accept, let me know.

MsgJp:
あ、あんた
前に言ってた《マグサス古水路》に向かうための
橋だけど、修復が終わったから
自由に通っていいからね！
MsgEn:
Ah, it's you. This is the bridge that leads to the
Magusas Ancient Canal I mentioned before.
The repairs are done, so feel free to pass through!

MsgJp:
でも、いざ《マグサス古水路》の封鎖を
解こうとしたら、突然鎧の魔物が出てきてね――
鍵を奪われちまったのさ
MsgEn:
But when we tried to unblock
the Magusas Ancient Canal,
suddenly an armored enemy appeared...
And they stole the key!

MsgJp:
鎧の魔物は
そこらへんをウロウロしてるから
討伐しさえすれば問題は解決なんだけどね
MsgEn:
The armored enemies are wandering around there,
so if we just defeat them, that'll fix the problem.

MsgJp:
討伐に向かう戦士を決める
ところまではいったんだけど
最近は侵食魔の動きも活発だろ？
村の守りを固めるのが先になっちゃったんだよ――
MsgEn:
We've decided on the warriors who will head out
for the expedition, but lately, the movements
of the Corrupted have been quite active, haven't they?
We had to prioritize fortifying the villages first.

MsgJp:
地鳴りは問題だけど、子供もいるこの村の
守りを固めることが何より大切なんだよ――
うちの戦士たちも、この状況で村を放ってまで
外に行きたがるような子たちじゃないからね
MsgEn:
While the earthquake is a problem, the most
important thing is to strengthen the defense
of this village, where our children dwell.
Our soldiers are not so immature to leave
the fortifications in this situation, you know.

MsgJp:
――そうだ、あんたが手伝ってくれたら
あたしら、すっごく助かるんだけど――
お礼はするよ、どう？
MsgEn:
If you could help us, we would be really grateful... 
We'll make sure to thank you, how about that?

MsgJp:
もし手伝ってくれるなら
元々調査に行くはずだった戦士を紹介するから
その件でもう一度話しかけてもらえるかい
MsgEn:
If you're willing to help, allow me to introduce
a soldier who was originally supposed to go
on the investigation. Could you talk to them
about that matter again?

MsgJp:
そうそう！　この前は《<SPOT 921>》の
魔物の討伐に行ってくれてありがとうね！
エリアマスターとして、お礼を言っとくよ
MsgEn:
Oh, right! Thank you so much for going to defeat
the enemy in the <SPOT 921> the other day! 
As an Area Master, I express my deepest gratitude.

MsgJp:
あの後、《マグサス古水路》の封鎖も
解いておいたよ
MsgEn:
Afterwards, I also unblocked
the Magusas Ancient Canal.

MsgJp:
何せ古将の墓ってだけあって
昔から時々盗掘者が出るようなところでね――
多分、中では武具か何かが手に入るはずさ
MsgEn:
Considering that it's the tomb of an esteemed
ancient general, it's no wonder that occasionally,
there are grave robbers, you know. 
Perhaps inside, we can find some useful equipment.

MsgJp:
あんたも興味があったら行ってみな！
なに、色々手伝ってくれてるんだ
自由に入ってくれていいよ
あたしが許すんだから
MsgEn:
If you're interested, you should give it a try too!
What? You've been helping me with various things.
You're free to enter. I'll allow it.

MsgJp:
あんたも感じること、あるかい？
最近は特に地鳴りがひどくなってきたじゃないか
MsgEn:
Do you also feel it? Lately, the earthquakes
have been getting worse, haven't they?

MsgJp:
やっぱり、いよいよタラスクの出現が
近いみたいだね――
MsgEn:
Indeed, it seems that the appearance
of the Tarasque is finally near.

MsgJp:
あんたもいざという時のために
装備や道具なんかには気を付けときな！
MsgEn:
You should also be careful with your equipment
and tools in case of emergencies!

MsgJp:
そういや、あんた《白骨岩》は知ってる？
ここら辺で時々採れる鉱石なんだけど
何かに使えると思うから、見つけたら採っとくといい
いいかい、戦士たるもの常に備え、だよ
MsgEn:
By the way, have you heard of White Bone Rock? 
It's a type of ore that can be found around here. 
I think it can be useful for something,
so it's a good idea to collect it
if you come across it. Remember, as a soldier,
you should always be prepared.

MsgJp:
ちょうどいいところに来てくれたじゃないか！
大事件だよ！
――とうとうタラスクが現れたのさ！
MsgEn:
You came at just the right time, didn't you!
It's a huge event!
...The Tarasque has finally appeared!

MsgJp:
さっそくうちの戦士たちが討伐に向かったんだけど
今まで侵食魔との戦いもあって
みんな疲労してたんだろうね――
負けて帰ってきちまってさ――
MsgEn:
Our warriors immediately headed out to subdue it,
but they've been battling the Corrupted until now,
so I guess everyone was exhausted...
And so they ended up returning in defeat...

MsgJp: 獣の将が魔物を呼び寄せようとしている――
MsgEn: The Beast Master is summoning enemies.

MsgJp: 状況が悪化し、獣の将が強き魔物を呼び寄せる――！
MsgEn:
The situation worsens as the Beast Master
summons powerful enemies!

MsgJp: 召喚された魔物を一掃した――
地下宝物庫を塞ぐ扉が開いた――！
MsgEn:
The door blocking the underground
Treasure Vault has opened!

MsgJp: 9０秒後にリザルトへ移行します
MsgEn: You will be transferred to results in 90 seconds

MsgJp: 敵増援部隊に砦陣内を奪われそうだ――
MsgEn:
The enemy reinforcements
are about to take over the fortress.

MsgJp: 獣の将が逃げ出しそうだ――
MsgEn: The Beast Commander is about to escape.

MsgJp:
砦に潜む魔竜軍雑兵を全滅させた――
戦況ゲージが回復した！
MsgEn:
Eliminated all enemy troops lurking in the fortress.
War status gauge has recovered!

MsgJp:
敵隊の討伐に成功！！
大砲の増強を阻止した！
MsgEn:
Successfully defeated the enemy forces!
Prevented cannon reinforcement.

MsgJp:
敵隊の討伐に失敗――
砦内の大砲が増えてしまった！
MsgEn:
Failed to defeat the enemy forces...
Number of cannons has increased!

MsgJp:
番兵の討伐に失敗――
砲撃場への突入チャンスを逃した
MsgEn:
Failed to defeat the sentries...
Missed the chance to break into the artillery area.

MsgJp:
砦内の大砲を全て破壊した――
戦況ゲージが回復した！
MsgEn:
Destroyed all the cannons inside the fortress!
War status gauge has recovered!
Failed to advance within the time limit...

MsgJp: 敵陣旗を破壊し、雑兵の援軍を抑えた！
MsgEn:
Destroyed the enemy flag and suppressed
the reinforcements of the soldiers!

MsgJp: ダクレイム砦奪還戦　戦況：大将討滅
MsgEn: Dacreim Fortress Recapture Battle: Boss Annihilation

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦に獣の将が出現した！
この砦を占領した魔竜軍のリーダー格を
白竜の覚者達が一丸となって追い詰めたのだ
次々と手下を使役し、集団となって襲い来る獣の将は
手下の力を借りて更に強力な魔物を呼び寄せる力を
持っているようだ――使役される魔物への対処で
戦局は大きく左右することになるだろう
MsgEn:
A Beast Commander has appeared at Dacreim Fortress! 
The Arisen of the White Dragon, united as one,
cornered the leader of the demonic dragon army
that had occupied this fortress. 

The Beast Commander, who sends minions
one after another and attacks in groups,
seems to possess the power to summon even stronger
monsters by borrowing the power of their minions. 

How we handle the monsters they control
will greatly sway the tide of battle.

MsgJp: ダクレイム砦を征圧する（残り２０分）
ダクレイム砦を征圧する（残り１９分）
ダクレイム砦を征圧する（残り１８分）

MsgJp: 蘇りし絶望の炎　戦況：悪しき竜再誕
MsgEn:
Resurrection of the Flame of Despair:
Evil Dragon Reborn

MsgJp:
火垂れ山にて、ネド王子と白竜の覚者により滅ぼされ
た悪しき竜だったが、四散した禍々しき竜力は
大地の浄化の流れに背くように山の不滅の炎と結び
つき、再び絶望を吐き散らす竜の姿となり動き出した
蘇った悪しき竜を討ち破り、つなぎ止めた希望を
死守せよ！
MsgEn:
At Firefall Mountain, the Evil Dragon,
who was thought to be destroyed by Prince Nedo
and the Arisen of the White Dragon, has arisen again.
The malevolent dragon power that scattered has
merged with the everlasting flame of the mountain,
going against the flow of the earth's purification,
and has taken on the form of a dragon once again,
spewing darkness and despair.
Defeat the revived Evil Dragon and protect the hope
that has been bound and preserved!

MsgJp: アッカーシェラン追懐戦記
アッカーシェラン追懐戦記

絶望に覆われた大地――
悪しき竜とその軍勢によって、全てが奪われたこの地で
覚者は戦い、消えかけていた希望を確かなものに
変えていった――
白竜の覚者よ、アッカーシェランを襲った数々の脅威に
今再び立ち向かえ
MsgEn:
The land is covered in despair...
In this land where everything has been taken
by the Evil Dragon and its forces, 
the Arisen fought to turn the fading hope
into something certain...
O, Arisen of the White Dragon,
face once again the numerous threats
that have befallen Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦――白竜神殿への魔物侵入をとどめる
最重要拠点のひとつである
北部からのオーク軍侵攻を阻むため、覚者レオ統率と
ヴァネッサ副隊長が率いる最前線部隊への参加人員が
今回も徴募される
連係戦術で悪鬼どもを葬り、レスタニアの平穏を護れ
MsgEn:
Fort Gritten is one of the most critical strongholds,
aimed at preventing the intrusion of monsters
into the White Dragon Temple.
In order to repel the Orc forces invading
from the north, Arisen Leo leads the way,
and Deputy Commander Vanessa
leads the frontline unit. Once again,
personnel have been recruited to join these forces.
Through coordinated tactics,
let's bury those fiends and protect the peace of Lestania.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿・中央広場のアランより
攻防戦の詳細について確認せよ
MsgEn:
From Alan of The White Dragon Temple,
Central Plaza, please confirm the battle plans.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦にオーク軍の接近が確認された
覚者諸君は防衛戦に備え、神殿大門前に集まれ
護りの力、いざ結束の時！
MsgEn:
Fort Gritten has confirmed the approach of the Orc army.
All Arisen comrades, gather in front of the temple gate,
preparing for the defense.
It's time to unite our protective strength!

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　戦況：接戦
MsgEn:
The mission is underway.
Battle status: Close combat

MsgJp:
オーク軍との大規模戦闘が始まっている
まだ脅威は少なく、新兵でも充分活躍できるが
油断は禁物だ
MsgEn:
The large-scale combat with the Orc army has begun.
There is still little threat, and even new recruits
can contribute adequately.
Letting your guard down is forbidden.

MsgJp:
オーク軍と刃を交える大規模戦闘が始まっている
敵軍は数こそいるが斥候クラスがほとんどで
深刻な脅威とはならないと目される
新兵にも活躍の機会は充分にあるはずだ
とはいえ連係戦闘を意識しなければ思わぬ怪我をする
心して挑むがいい
MsgEn:
A large-scale battle has begun
between the Orc army and our forces.
Although the enemy outnumbers us,
most of them are scouts, so they are not
considered a serious threat.
There should be plenty of opportunities
for new recruits to shine. However,
it is important to be aware of coordinated combat
to avoid unexpected injuries. Approach with caution.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　戦況：接戦
MsgEn:
The mission is underway.
Battle status: Close combat

MsgJp:
難易度が増した大規模戦闘に挑め
日々の経験を生かせば、強敵も畏れることはない
仲間との連携に注力せよ
MsgEn:
Take on the challenge of large-scale battles
with increased difficulty. With daily experience,
even the strongest enemies are not to be feared.
Focus on cooperation with your friends.

MsgJp:
多少難易度が上がり手ごたえの増した大規模戦闘だ
敵兵にも強い個体が増えてきている
だが日ごろの経験を生かして望めば怖くないはず
基本を忘れず周囲に気を配れ
仲間の動きを見極めてこその連係だ
MsgEn:
The difficulty level has increased
and it has become a large-scale combat
with a greater sense of accomplishment.
The number of strong enemy soldiers has also increased. 
However, if we apply our daily experience, it shouldn't be daunting.
Remember the basics and pay attention to your surroundings.
It's all about coordination, discerning your comrades' movements.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　戦況：苦戦
MsgEn:
The mission is underway.
Battle status: Struggling

MsgJp:
新兵には厳しい大規模戦闘となる
狂暴かつ狡猾な敵に個人技だけでは
太刀打ちできない弱点をついて連係せよ
MsgEn:
It will be a tough and large-scale battle for new recruits.
In order to overcome the fierce and cunning enemies
that cannot be dealt with by individual skills alone,
exploit their weaknesses and coordinate attacks.

MsgJp:
新兵には荷の重い大規模戦闘となる
敵は狂暴性を増しながらも隙のない動きを見せてくる
勘やセンスに頼った個人技を振りまわすだけでは
勝機は薄いだろう
連係をつなぎ敵の弱点を見逃すな
MsgEn:
For new recruits, it will be a heavy burden
of large-scale combat. The enemy will come at us
with increasing ferocity, but showing no openings in their movements.
Relying solely on intuition and individual skills will provide little chance of victory.
Do not overlook the enemy's weak points, but connect your attacks strategically.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　戦況：苦戦
MsgEn:
The mission is underway.
Battle status: Struggling

MsgJp:
主力部隊との大規模戦闘だ
好戦的な尖兵の投入により、難易度は増している
一瞬の気の緩みが致命傷になると心得よ
MsgEn:
This is a large-scale combat with the main force.
The difficulty has increased due to the aggressive deployment of elite troops.
Keep in mind that a momentary lapse of concentration can be fatal.

MsgJp:
敵の主力部隊が進出してくる本格大規模戦闘だ
好戦的で戦技に長けた尖兵が前線に投入され
確実に致命傷を負わせにかかってきている
すばやく的確な決断が必須となるだろう
一瞬たりとも気を抜くな
MsgEn:
This is a full-scale large-scale battle with the enemy's main force advancing.
Aggressive and skilled vanguards have been deployed to the front lines
and are coming to inflict fatal blows reliably.
Quick and accurate decision-making will be essential.
Do not let your guard down for even a moment.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　戦況：激戦
MsgEn:
The mission is underway.
Battle status: Fierce battle

MsgJp:
熟練者でも致命傷を負う可能性のある
難度の高い大規模戦闘となる
歴戦をくぐった強敵を前に無傷では済まされない
MsgEn:
Even the most seasoned of us can be mortally wounded.
It's a difficult, large-scale battle.
You can't go unscathed in the face of a powerful enemy
who has fought many battles in his career.

MsgJp:
熟練者でないと攻略が難しい高難度大規模戦闘だ
過去に何人もの覚者をほふった、いわくつきの
戦士らが集結するとみられる
戦闘経験の浅い者など数分と生き残れまい
もはや誰しも無傷では済まされないと覚悟しろ
MsgEn:
This is a high-difficulty large-scale battle
that is difficult to conquer without being an expert.
It is said that renowned warriors who have slaughtered
numerous Arisen in the past will gather.
Those with little combat experience
will not survive even for a few minutes.
Prepare yourself, as no one will come out unscathed anymore.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　戦況：激戦
MsgEn:
The mission is underway.
Battle status: Fierce battle

MsgJp:
熟達戦士による総力戦となるのは必至の
苛烈な大規模戦闘だ
判断ミスは仲間の全滅につながると心せよ
MsgEn:
It is inevitable that the intense, large-scale battle
will turn into an all-out war led by skilled soldiers.
Always keep in mind that a judgment error
can lead to the complete annihilation of your comrades.

MsgJp:
熟達した戦士が総力を結集する大規模戦闘になる
圧倒的な狂暴さとタフさ、高度な戦術を持った敵が
大挙して襲ってくるだろう
戦闘巧者とてあっけなくやられる場合がある
ひとつの判断ミスが仲間の全滅につながると思え
MsgEn:
It will be a large-scale battle where seasoned soldiers
gather their full strength. The enemy possesses
overwhelming ferocity, toughness, and advanced tactics.
They will come in great numbers to attack.
Even skilled warriors can be easily defeated.
One miscalculation can lead to the complete annihilation of our allies.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　戦況：決死戦
MsgEn:
The mission is underway.
Battle status: Life-and-death struggle

MsgJp:
悪夢の大群が押し寄せる大規模戦闘だ
己の腕と奇跡、白竜の加護を信じるしかない
さあ覚者の矜持を見せよ！
MsgEn:
A massive battle where hordes of nightmares surge forward.
We have no choice but to believe in our own skills,
miracles, and the protection of the White Dragon.
Now, let us show the pride of the Arisen!

MsgJp:
全員が生きて帰れるかどうかわからない
決死の大規模戦闘がついに始まってしまった
地獄の扉が開き、悪夢がなだれ込んでくる
確実な勝機などどこにもない
己の腕を信じ、仲間を信じ、奇跡を信じるほかはない
白竜の加護を胸に、覚者の矜持を見せろ！
MsgEn:
I don't know if everyone will return alive.
The desperate large-scale battle has finally begun.
The gates of hell open and nightmares come pouring in.
There is no certain chance of victory anywhere.
Believe in your own abilities, believe in your comrades, and believe in miracles.
With the White Dragon's protection in your heart, show the dignity of the Arisen!

MsgJp:
防衛戦ごくろうだった！
諸君らの活躍により敵軍は退却、沈静化した
現在戦果報酬を確認中だ、しばし待つがいい
MsgEn:
The defense battle was a tough one!
Thanks to everyone's efforts, the enemy forces
have retreated and the situation has calmed down.
We are currently in the process
of confirming the battle results and rewards.
Please wait for a moment.

MsgJp:
防衛戦での戦果が確定した
各自、担当者アランより報酬を受け取るがいい
MsgEn:
The results of the defensive battle have been finalized.
Each of you will receive your reward from Alan, the man in charge.

MsgJp:
誰が名付けたかその名も《竜の巣》――
そこには凶悪なドラゴンや魔物の大群が
巣食うようになっている
さあ死を畏れぬ猛者たちよ、洋撃船の準備ができたら
大船長ゼルキンとともにやつらの寝床に乗り込め！
極上の冒険が待ってるぞ！
MsgEn:
Whoever named it, its name is "Dragon's Nest."
A horde of vicious dragons and enemies have made it their lair. 
Now, brave warriors who fear not death, 
Once the steam-powered ship is ready, 
Board their sleeping place with Captain Zerkin! 
An extraordinary adventure awaits!

MsgJp:
白竜神殿・港洞のゼルキンより
作戦詳細について説明を受けよ
MsgEn:
From Zerkin of The White Dragon Temple in Cave Harbor,
please receive an explanation regarding the details of the operation.

MsgJp:
大船長ゼルキンの洋撃船が、
≪魔物のるつぼ≫へ進路を向け着々と出港準備中！
狙うは爆炎の大竜、エルダードラゴン！！
MsgEn:
Captain Zerkin's western warship is steadily preparing
to set sail towards the Crucible of Demons!
Their target: the mighty Elder Dragon of fire and brimstone!

MsgJp:
命知らずども！白竜神殿港洞に集まれ！
爆炎の大竜、エルダードラゴンを仕留めるため
≪魔物のるつぼ≫へ飛び込め！
MsgEn:
Attention, Daredevils!
Gather at the Cave Harbor of the White Dragon Temple!
We must defeat the Elder Dragon of Flames.
Dive into the Crucible of Demons!

MsgJp:
洋撃船の仕上がりは万端！
≪魔物のるつぼ≫への侵攻作戦は意気揚々と展開中だ！
爆炎の大竜、エルダードラゴンを仕留められるかは
おまえたちの腕と運しだい！
値千金、一攫千金の戦いに持てる戦技の全てをぶつけよ！
MsgEn:
The finishing touches on the Western assault ship are perfect!
The invasion operation of the Crucible of Demons
is progressing with high spirits!
Whether we can bring down the mighty Elder Dragon,
a raging inferno, depends on your skills and luck!
Unleash all the battle techniques that can lead to a fortune,
invaluable in this battle!

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　特報：敵勢力減退中！
MsgEn:
Mission in Progress Special Report：
Enemy forces weakening!

MsgJp:
洋撃船による侵攻作戦は順調に展開中だ
幸運なことに敵の大将は弱り目らしいぞ
戦果をあげろ！
MsgEn:
The invasion operation by the ocean assault ships
is progressing smoothly. Fortunately,
it appears the enemy leader is weakened.
Go forth and achieve great results!

MsgJp:
洋撃船の仕上がりは万端
魔物の巣への侵攻作戦は意気揚々と展開中だ
命知らずどもに朗報をやろう
今回は敵の大将どもの弱り目につけこめそうだ
こんなチャンスはめったにないぞ
一気にたたみかけて根こそぎかっさらえ！
MsgEn:
The finishing of the attack ship is perfect.
The invasion operation to the enemy's nest
is unfolding with great enthusiasm.
Let's give some good news to the daredevils;
This time, we can take advantage of the weakness
of the enemy's generals. Such opportunities are rare.
Quickly overwhelm them and take everything!

MsgJp:
覚者の活躍で戦果は上々、船長も大満足だったぜ
壊れた船の修繕がてら報酬配分を計算中だ
もうしばらく待ってくれ
MsgEn:
The performance of the Arisen has been excellent,
and the captain is very satisfied.
They are calculating the distribution of rewards
while repairing the broken ship.
Please wait a little longer.

MsgJp:
待たせたな猛者ども、報酬配分が決まったぜ
活躍に応じた平等な配分だ、遠慮なく
受け取ってくれ、次回の出港もよろしくな！
MsgEn:
Sorry for the wait, fierce ones,
the reward distribution has been decided.
It's an equal distribution based on your performance,
feel free to take it, and we'll see you on the next departure!

MsgJp:
《ボルド大坑道》に腐死竜の召喚を目論む
魔物の軍勢が集まってきている――
どうやらすでに召喚の儀を終えてしまった後のようだ
脅威はそればかりではなく、腐死竜の召喚をした
魔物たちは更なる軍勢の拡大を狙っているらしい
各召喚士群を全滅させ、最奥に潜む腐死竜へ挑め
MsgEn:
Planning to summon the Rotting Dragon
in the Volden Large Tunnels,
a horde of enemies has gathered...!
It seems they have already completed the summoning ritual.
But the threat doesn't stop there;
they've already succeeded in summoning the Rotting Dragon.
The enemies seem to be aiming to expand their forces even further.
Wipe out all groups of summoners and challenge the Rotting Dragon
lurking at the deepest part.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿・騎士団詰所のデュークと話し
ゲルト団長からの通達について確認せよ
MsgEn:
Talk to Duke at the White Dragon Temple Knight's Quarters
and confirm the message from Captain Gerd.

MsgJp:
ボルド大坑道にて召喚士の名を持つワイトの軍勢が
魔物を呼び寄せている
魔壁を打ち破り、封印された最奥の地へ急げ
MsgEn:
In the Volden Large Tunnels,
an army of Summoner Wights is conjuring enemies.
Break through the magic barrier and head with haste
to the deepest sealed grounds.

MsgJp:
ボルド大坑道にて召喚士の名を持つワイトの軍勢が
魔物を呼び寄せている
白衛騎士団が部隊を投じて調査にあたっていたが
早期の対処が必須とゲルト団長が判断
覚者への協力要請が伝えられた
召喚士群を至急全滅させ、封印せし魔壁内部へ急げ
MsgEn:
In the Volden Large Tunnels,
an army of Summoner Wights is conjuring enemies.
The White Knight Order has deployed a unit
to investigate the situation. Captain Gerd
has deemed early intervention essential, and a request
for assistance has been delivered to the Arisen.
Hurry and eliminate the group of summoners,
and make your way inside the sealed magical wall.

MsgJp:
カースドラゴンの完全復活は防がれた
各々の戦果については追って報告があるので
それまでは待機とする
MsgEn:
The complete revival of the Cursed Dragon was prevented.
We will provide further reports on each individual battle achievement,
so please remain on standby until then.
The Deathly Battle of the Ancient Temple

MsgJp:
おぞましい数の侵食魔が《シェドレアン大神殿》に
跋扈しはじめた――魔物は神殿全域を蝕んでいるため
討伐隊メンバーを２手に分けて一気に殲滅する作戦を
遂行中とのことだ
侵食が極度に進行した魔物も確認されているようで
侵食魔への対策は怠らぬよう厳命が下っている
MsgEn: A horde of abominable, corrupted creatures has begun to run rampant in the Shadolean Great Temple. The members of the extermination squad have divided into two groups, carrying out a coordinated assault to annihilate them all at once. It has been reported that some of the creatures have been severely corrupted. Urgent orders have been given to ensure that countermeasures against the corruption are not neglected.

MsgJp:
ダナ・セントラムのデリーンより
シェドレアン大神殿での問題を確認せよ
MsgEn:
From Deryn of Dana Centrum,
Please verify the issue at the Shadolean Great Temple.

MsgJp:
フィンダム大陸にて、侵食魔の動きが
活発になっているとの情報が届いている
ファーラナ平原にあるダナ村にて詳細を調べよ
MsgEn: We have received information that the movement of the corrupted has become active in the continent of Phindym. Investigate the details in the village of Dana in the Farana Plains.

MsgJp:
シェドレアン大神殿全域に侵食魔が出現した
アデルドナハと共する戦士が、急ぎ対応に向かったが
おびただしい数の侵食魔を前に救援要請が届いている
シェドレアン大神殿へ進攻し、侵食魔の拡がりを
最小限に食い止めよ
MsgEn: The infected demons have appeared in the entire area of the Shadolean Great Temple. The soldiers who accompany Adair Donnchadh hurriedly headed to respond, but a request for reinforcement has been received in front of an enormous number of infected demons. Proceed to the Shadolean Great Temple and stop the spread of the infection as much as possible.

MsgJp:
古代神殿に巣食った侵食魔は一掃された
レスタニアの覚者への戦果は後程、通達される
それまでは待機とする
MsgEn: The corruption that had nested itself in the ancient temple has been completely eradicated. The achievements of the Arisen in Lestania will be conveyed at a later time. Until then, please remain on standby.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦を悪しき竜軍が征服したようだ
場内はオークや大型の魔物で各エリアが占領され
大砲の弾が容赦なく降り注ぐ戦闘地帯となっている
まずは砦内へ進攻する手段を企て、戦況を好転させよ
悪しき竜軍側の反撃を抑え戦力を削り、砦最奥に潜む
獣の将を討伐して砦を奪還するのだ
MsgEn: It seems that the evil Dragon Army has conquered the Dacreim Fortress. The area is occupied by orcs and large monsters, turning it into a battlefield where cannonballs rain mercilessly. First, we need to devise a plan to infiltrate the fortress and turn the tide of the battle. Suppress the evil Dragon Army's counterattack and weaken their forces, then defeat the Beast Master lurking in the depths of the fortress to reclaim it.

MsgJp:
ミッションに参加する場合は
ティネス砦のアシュトンより
詳細を確認せよ
MsgEn:
If you are participating in the mission,
please confirm the details from Ashton of Fort Thines.

伴う報酬を受け取ることが出来る
特別な報酬には受け取るための条件や上限数が

MsgJp:
ジフール砦を悪しき竜軍が征服したようだ
砦へ入るための跳ね橋は吊り上げられ
内部へ進入することも難しい――召喚士による魔物の
召喚が絶えず行われており敵軍の征圧を阻害してくる
召喚士への道は塞がれているが、砦内に点在する
呪符への対処が砦攻略の鍵となるだろう
MsgEn: It seems that the evil dragon army has conquered Jifule Fortress. The drawbridge for entering the fortress is raised, making it difficult to proceed inside. Summoners continuously summon monsters, hindering the enemy's suppression. While the path to the summoners is blocked, dealing with the runes scattered throughout the fortress is likely the key to capturing it.

MsgJp:
ミッションに参加する場合は
展望城にいるウォルトより
詳細を確認せよ
MsgEn: To join the mission, go to Walt at the Lookout Castle for more information.

MsgJp:
ジフール砦を悪しき竜軍が征服したようだ
砦へ入るための跳ね橋は吊り上げられ内部へ
進入することも難しい――更に、召喚士による
魔物の召喚が絶えず行われ骸の巣窟と化している
召喚士は砦中に呪符を仕掛けており、砦を攻め
落とすにはこれら罠への正確な対処が不可欠だ
MsgEn:
It seems that the Evil Dragon Army
has conquered Jifule Fortress.
The drawbridge for entering the fortress is raised,
making it difficult to proceed inside.

Furthermore, summoners continually
increase the number of enemies,
turning it into a nest of corpses.

The summoners have set amulets
throughout the fortress, and dealing with these
is essential to capturing the fortress.

MsgJp:
霧の森に突如、闇の軍勢が出現した
内部は複数のルートに分かれており
征圧ポイントが点在している
敵軍による突然の襲撃が予想されており
慌ただしく変化する戦況を見定めながら
戦い抜かねばならない
MsgEn:
Suddenly, a dark army appeared in the Forest of Mist.
The interior is divided into multiple routes,
with various conquer points scattered throughout.
A sudden attack by the enemy forces is anticipated,
and we must fight through the rapidly changing battlefield
while assessing the situation.

MsgJp:
ミッションに参加する場合は
メガドにいるアッバスより
詳細を確認せよ
MsgEn: If you are participating in the mission, please confirm the details from Abbas at Megado.

MsgJp:
火垂れ山にて、ネド王子と白竜の覚者により滅ぼされた
悪しき竜だったが、四散した禍々しき竜力は
大地の浄化の流れに背くように山の不滅の炎と結び
つき、再び絶望を吐き散らす竜の姿となり動き出した
蘇った悪しき竜を討ち破り、つなぎ止めた希望を
死守せよ！
MsgEn: At Firefall Mountain, the evil dragon, who was destroyed by Prince Nedo and the Arisen of the White Dragon, has arisen again. The malevolent dragon power that scattered has merged with the everlasting flame of the mountain, going against the flow of the earth's purification, and has taken on the form of a dragon once again, spewing despair. Defeat the revived evil dragon and protect the hope that has been bound and preserved!

MsgJp:
ミッションに参加する場合は
火垂れ山野営地にいるザカリーより
詳細を確認せよ
MsgEn: If you are participating in the mission, please confirm the details from Zachary at the Firefall Mountain Campsite.

MsgJp:
火垂れ山にて、ネド王子と白竜の覚者により滅ぼされた
悪しき竜だったが、四散した禍々しき竜力は
大地の浄化の流れに背くように山の不滅の炎と結び
つき、再び絶望を吐き散らす竜の姿となり動き出した
蘇った悪しき竜を討ち破り、つなぎ止めた希望を
死守せよ！
MsgEn: At Firefall Mountain, the evil dragon, who was destroyed by Prince Nedo and the Arisen of the White Dragon, has arisen again. The malevolent dragon power that scattered has merged with the everlasting flame of the mountain, going against the flow of the earth's purification, and has taken on the form of a dragon once again, spewing despair. Defeat the revived evil dragon and protect the hope that has been bound and preserved!

MsgJp:
火垂れ山にて、ネド王子と白竜の覚者により滅ぼされた
悪しき竜だったが、四散した禍々しき竜力は
大地の浄化の流れに背くように山の不滅の炎と結び
つき、再び絶望を吐き散らす竜の姿となり動き出した
蘇った悪しき竜を討ち破り、つなぎ止めた希望を
死守せよ！
MsgEn: At Firefall Mountain, the evil dragon, who was destroyed by Prince Nedo and the Arisen of the White Dragon, has arisen again. The malevolent dragon power that scattered has merged with the everlasting flame of the mountain, going against the flow of the earth's purification, and has taken on the form of a dragon once again, spewing despair. Defeat the revived evil dragon and protect the hope that has been bound and preserved!

MsgJp: アッカーシェラン追懐戦記

絶望に覆われた大地――
悪しき竜とその軍勢によって、全てが奪われたこの地で
覚者は戦い、消えかけていた希望を確かなものに
変えていった――
白竜の覚者よ、アッカーシェランを襲った数々の脅威に
今再び立ち向かえ
MsgEn:
The land is covered in despair...
In this land where everything has been taken
by the Evil Dragon and its forces, 
the Arisen fought to turn the fading hope
into something certain...
O, Arisen of the White Dragon,
face once again the numerous threats
that have befallen Acre Selund.

メガドにいるレイモンドより

MsgJp:
レスタニアの地に災いを為す存在、魔物たち――
やつらの勢力が強まる背景には、何があるのか？
《古の祭祀場》に襲い来る、異界を渡るとされる
強敵の存在がその疑問への答えになるかも知れない
白竜の子らよ、畏れを忘れず脅威に立ち向かえ
やつらの進撃をこれ以上許してはならない
MsgEn: In the land of Lestania, exist the creatures that bring calamity — the enemies, the monsters. What lies behind their growing power? The answer may lie in the formidable presence that crosses over from the "Ancient Ritual Ground," said to connect to a different realm. Sons and daughters of the White Dragon, confront the threat without forgetting to fear it. We cannot allow the further advance of these creatures.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿・騎士団詰所のローガンと話し
強敵への備えについて把握せよ
MsgEn: Talk to Logan of the White Dragon Temple Knights' Quarters about preparations for a formidable enemy.

MsgJp:
古の祭祀場にて闇の者たちの波動を感知している
騎士団はこれに対処すべく覚者らの協力を求める
MsgEn: At the Ancient Ritual Ground, the knights have detected waves of darkness from the dark beings. The knights seek the assistance of the Arisen to deal with this.

MsgJp:
古の祭祀場で魔物出現に対処中である
強力な敵個体も検知した、騎士団は
総力を尽くしているが覚者の協力が必須だ
MsgEn: In the Ancient Ritual Ground, we are currently dealing with the appearance of enemies. The knight order has detected powerful enemy individuals, and they are making every effort to handle the situation, but the cooperation of the Arisen is essential.

MsgJp:
古の祭祀場にて魔物出現への対処を開始している
騎士団討伐隊も死力を尽くしてこれに当たっているが
強力な魔物らを制するには覚者の協力が不可欠だ
また深部からは強力な個体のものと思われる波動が
検知されている
今は少しでも多くの応援が欲しい
MsgEn: At the Ancient Ritual Ground, measures to deal with the appearance of monsters have begun. The knight squad is also doing their best to face this, but the cooperation of the Arisen is essential to overcome powerful monsters. Furthermore, powerful waves, presumed to be from individual creatures in the depths, have been detected. We need as much support as possible right now.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　特報：敵勢力減退中！
MsgEn:
Mission in Progress Special Report：
Enemy forces weakening!

MsgJp:
古の祭祀場で魔物出現に対処中である
検知した強力な敵個体は弱体の傾向があるようだ
攻勢に出るため応援を求む
MsgEn:
We are currently dealing with the appearance of enemies in the Ancient Ritual Ground.
The powerful enemy individuals that were detected seem to have a tendency towards weakness.
We request reinforcements in order to launch an offensive.

MsgJp:
古の祭祀場にて魔物出現への対処を開始している
騎士団討伐隊も死力を尽くしてこれに当たっているが
強力な魔物らを制するには覚者の協力が不可欠だ
なお深部で感知されている強力な個体の波動に
一部乱れのようなものが認められたらしい
もし攻勢をかける好機ならば、より応援が必要だ
MsgEn: Efforts have begun to deal with the appearance of monsters at the ancient ritual site. The Order of Knights' extermination team is also doing its utmost in this regard, but the cooperation of the Arisen is essential to control these powerful monsters. Additionally, it seems that there has been some disturbance detected in the waves from the powerful individual sensed in the depths. If there's an opportune moment to launch an offensive, even more support will be required.

MsgJp:
祭祀場での事態は収束した
覚者の協力に感謝する、戦況報告がまとまったら
戦果報酬を配分しよう、しばらく待機してくれ
MsgEn: The situation at the ritual site has been brought under control. We are grateful for the assistance of the Arisen. Once the battle report is compiled, we will distribute the spoils of war. Please wait patiently for a while.

MsgJp:
報酬配分が確定した
覚者は受け取り手続きを済ませてくれ
今後も騎士と覚者は協力して事態解決に当たろう
MsgEn:
The distribution of rewards has been finalized.
Arisen, please complete the necessary steps for receiving them.
In the future, the Knight and Arisen shall cooperate to resolve the situation.

MsgJp:
黄金竜の脅威が目前に迫っている
その真意はいまだ不明だが、奴の接近を放置すれば
レスタニアの地は災いに沈むだろう
いまこそ神殿に集いし覚者たちの総力を束ねるときだ
その一撃が、その執念が、黄金竜を確実に追い詰める
白竜の座すこの世界をともに護るのだ
MsgEn: The threat of the Golden Dragon is imminent. Although its true intentions are still unknown, if we ignore its approach, the land of Lestania will be doomed. Now is the time for the Arisen to gather at the temple and unite their collective strength. With a single strike and unwavering determination, we will surely corner and overcome the Golden Dragon. Together, we shall protect this world, the seat of the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿・謎の礎近くにいるハンコックより
決戦への参加について情報を集めろ
MsgEn: From Hancock, who is near the Mysterious Portcrystal close to The White Dragon Temple, gather information about participating in the decisive battle.

MsgJp:
黄金竜はこれまでの敵とは比べ物にならない
強さだ、勇気ある覚者も充分な準備を整えて
決戦に臨んでくれ
MsgEn: The Golden Dragon is incomparable to previous enemies in terms of strength, so please, courageous Arisen, make thorough preparations and face the decisive battle.

MsgJp:
黄金竜との決戦が展開中だ、こちらは数で
優位にあるが、奴の勢いは衰えを知らない
さらなる覚者の応援を請う
MsgEn: The battle with the Golden Dragon is currently underway. We have the numerical advantage, but its momentum shows no sign of weakening. We request further support from the Arisen.

MsgJp:
決戦の地では激しい戦いが展開されている
黄金竜の勢いは衰えを知らず、数で有利な我々も
一瞬たりとも気を抜けない状況だ
白竜との因縁深きやつの接近をこれ以上許せば
レスタニアの地が危ない
勇士よ集え、さらなる覚者の応援を請う
MsgEn: A fierce battle is unfolding at the battlefield. The momentum of the Golden Dragon shows no signs of waning, and despite our numerical advantage, we can't afford to let our guard down for even a moment. If we allow that one, deeply fated with the White Dragon to approach any further, the land of Lestania will be in danger. Warriors, come together, and we request further support from the Arisen.

MsgJp: 本作戦進行中　特報：敵勢力減退中！
MsgEn:
Mission in Progress Special Report：
Enemy forces weakening!

MsgJp:
黄金竜との決戦が展開中だ
激戦だが奴の動きにスキが認められるようだ
この好機に一気に攻め込みたい、支援を請う
MsgEn:
The battle with the Golden Dragon is currently underway.
It's a fierce fight, but it seems there are openings in his movements.
I want to take advantage of this opportunity and launch a sudden attack. I request your support.

MsgJp:
決戦の地では激しい戦いが展開されている
変わらず黄金竜の勢いはすさまじいが、奴の動きに
不自然なものを感じるとの報告もある
これは、奴が力尽きる寸前だという兆候かも知れない
過信は禁物だが、この機を逃さず注意深く攻めたい
覚者たちの支援を改めて強く求める
MsgEn:
On the battlefield where the decisive battle is taking place, the formidable force of the Golden Dragon remains unchanged, but there are reports of unnatural movements from it.
This may be a sign that it is nearing exhaustion.
While we should not be overconfident, we should carefully attack without missing this opportunity.
Once again, we strongly request the support of the Arisen in our endeavors.

MsgJp:
黄金竜の撃退に成功した
覚者の連携力と勇気がこの成果に繋がったのだ
戦果は追って報告する、白竜に感謝し待つがいい
MsgEn:
The Golden Dragon has been successfully repelled.
The cooperation and bravery of the Arisen led to this achievement.
The results of the battle will be reported later, we thank the White Dragon and await its return.

MsgJp:
健闘を讃え報酬を配分する
この経験を活かしさらなる精進に励んでくれ
黄金竜は必ずまた来る、次回も協力よろしく頼む
MsgEn: We applaud your valiant efforts and will distribute the rewards. Please make use of this experience and strive for further improvement. The Golden Dragon will definitely come again, so please cooperate with us next time.

MsgJp:
アーク目撃の影響を受けてか、レスタニアにて
これまでにない異質な気配が感じられるようになった
騎士団は異質な気配を警戒している
しばらくの間、特別迎撃態勢をとることにした
覚者諸君においては、各自充分な備えをもって
これに対処してほしい
MsgEn: Perhaps as a result of witnessing the Ark, a distinct presence has begun to be felt in Lestania. The knights are on alert for this unusual presence and have decided to assume a special defensive position for a while. For the Arisen, it is requested that each individual be adequately prepared to handle this situation.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿・商店区付近のコーネリアを訪ね
異形な魔物の気配について尋ねよ
MsgEn: Visit Cornelia in the vicinity of the White Dragon Temple and the Shopping District and inquire about the presence of abnormal creatures.

MsgJp:
謎の敵の出現の兆しがある、今より迎撃態勢を
告知する、協力を申し出た覚者は最優先で
対処に応じてくれ、騎士団も協力を惜しまない
MsgEn: There are signs of the mysterious enemy's appearance, so we are announcing the need to prepare for interception. The Arisen who offered their cooperation will be given top priority and responded to accordingly. The Knight Order also willingly offers their assistance.

MsgJp:
レスタニアで謎の敵が目撃されている
覚者は異質な魔物に対して
十分な警戒と備えを持って対処せよ
MsgEn:
In Lestania, an unknown enemy has been sighted.
The Arisen should be prepared and vigilant in dealing with these unfamiliar creatures.

MsgJp:
レスタニアで謎の敵影が目撃され
襲撃報告も入ってきている
各自、最悪の状況を想定して行動せよ
白竜は言う「覚者とは抜き身の刃、研がねば腐る」
いまこそその力、研ぎ澄ますのだ
MsgEn: A mysterious enemy presence has been spotted in Lestania, and there have been reports of attacks. Everyone, prepare for the worst-case scenario and act accordingly. The White Dragon says, "The Arisen is a blade unsheathed, it will perish if not honed." Now is the time to sharpen that power.

MsgJp:
レスタニアで謎の敵が目撃されている
強敵ではあるが、手負いの状態との報告もある
チャンスを逃さず対処せよ
MsgEn: A mysterious enemy has been sighted in Lestania. While formidable, there are also reports of it being in a wounded state. Don't miss the opportunity and deal with it.

MsgJp:
レスタニア全土で謎の敵影が目撃され
襲撃報告も入ってきている
なお一部の遭遇者によれば、敵の動きに怯みのような
違和感を感じたとある
これは千載一遇のチャンスかも知れない
相手が弱っているなら、容赦なく対処し排除せよ
MsgEn: Mysterious enemy shadows have been witnessed throughout the entire land of Lestania, and reports of attacks are coming in. According to some of the witnesses, they felt a sense of unease in the enemy's movements. This could be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. If the opponent is weakened, deal with them mercilessly and eliminate them.

MsgJp: 迎撃態勢解除　戦況分析中
MsgEn: Interception posture canceled. Analyzing war situation.

MsgJp:
事態は一定の収束をみた、迎撃態勢は解除する
覚者の協力については報酬を用意している
集計結果を待ってほしい
MsgEn: The situation has reached a certain resolution, and the interception preparations will be lifted. We have prepared rewards for the assistance of the Arisen. Please wait for the aggregation results.

MsgJp:
覚者への報酬が確定した
白竜の盾としての充分な活躍に感謝する
有事の際はまた協力を請う
MsgEn:
The reward for the Arisen has been determined.
We are grateful for your sufficient contribution as the Shield of the White Dragon.
In times of need, we will once again ask for your cooperation.

MsgJp:
アルタード・ズールによる魔赤島襲撃が
突如始まってしまった――
ズールを守らんとする魔物の存在も確認されている
不死身の存在を排除する手段はあるのだろうか？
幾度となく復活してくる強敵を、完全に滅ぼす
その時まで戦いは終わらない、平穏は訪れない
MsgEn:
A sudden attack by Altered Zuhl on Bloodbane Isle has begun.
The presence of enemies trying to protect Zuhl has also been confirmed.
Is there a way to eliminate this invincible existence?
The battle will not end until the formidable enemy, who keeps resurrecting countless times, is completely annihilated.
Peace will not come until that time.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿・港洞のトラバースより
魔赤島で起きた問題について確認せよ
MsgEn:
From Travers of the White Dragon Temple's Cave Harbor,
please verify the issue that occurred on Bloodbane Isle.

MsgJp:
アルタード・ズールとの戦いは続いている
入念な準備と効果的な戦略を用意して
対抗せよ
MsgEn:
The battle against the Altered Zuhl continues.
Prepare thoroughly and devise effective strategies.
Take on the challenge.

MsgJp:
アルタード・ズールの軍勢が、突如魔赤島への
襲撃を開始した
ズールの生命はやはり不死身なのだろうか
幾度となく復活を遂げる魔物への対処法はあるのか
今回こそは、ヤツを完全に仕留めるべく
考え得る最良の準備と戦略を用いて対抗せよ
MsgEn: The Altered Zuhl's army suddenly began their raid on Bloodbane Isle. Is Zuhl truly immortal? Is there a way to deal with the monsters that have repeatedly come back to life? This time, prepare and strategize with the best possible plan to completely take it down.

MsgJp:
今回もなんとかズールを退けることができた
現在、覚者一人一人の戦果を確認している
ヤツがまた復活したときは協力を頼みたい
MsgEn:
We were able to defeat Zuhl somehow once again this time.
Currently, we are confirming the achievements of each Arisen.
When that guy resurrects again, I'd like to ask for your cooperation.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの未来を賭けた精霊竜との戦いは
芯なる樹の樹内で起きた出来事のひとつとして
この聖なる不思議な場所に記憶された
その記憶を求める一部の覚者にとって
それは過去を越える壮絶な試練となって
相対することになるだろう
MsgEn: The battle with the Spirit Dragon for future of Phindym, was one of the events that took place inside Core Tree. The memory of this event was stored in this holy and mysterious place. For some Arisen who seek this memory, it will become a tremendous trial that surpasses the past, as they come face to face with it.

MsgJp:
ダナ・セントラムのリアガンより
芯なる樹が記憶する戦いについて確認せよ
MsgEn: From Riagan of Dana Centrum, confirm what the core tree remembers of the battle.

MsgJp:
ダナ・セントラムのリアガンより
芯なる樹が記憶する戦いについて
詳細を調べよ
MsgEn: From Riagan of Dana Centrum, confirm what the core tree remembers of the battle.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの未来を賭けた精霊竜との戦いは
芯なる樹の樹内で起きた出来事のひとつとして
この聖なる不思議な場所に記憶されている
再びその戦いの中に身を投じ、覚者として
壮絶な試練を乗り越えよ
MsgEn: The battle with the Spirit Dragon, which determined the future of Phindym, is one of the events that took place within the Core Tree. This holy and mysterious place holds the memory of that battle. Once again, immerse yourself in that battle as an Arisen. Overcome the fierce trials that await you.

MsgJp:
一部の覚者に向けた芯なる樹が記憶する
戦いへの挑戦は、一先ず終わったようだ
その試練を経た覚者へ、モードレットより
後程報酬が送られる
MsgEn:
To the Arisen who have successfully overcome the challenge, a reward will be sent from Modred later. 
The core tree, which holds the memories, is dedicated to a select few Arisen.
It seems that the battle has come to a temporary end.

MsgJp: セットボタンを連続して押す
セットボタンを連続して押す

セットボタンを押す
<COL ff7878>威力が最大となる高度からの攻撃で
戦甲へのカウンターに特化</COL>
MsgEn:
Press the assigned button.
<COL ff7878>Effective against War-Ready enemies if this skill is executed
from high position.</COL>

MsgJp: セットボタンを連続して押す
敵の攻撃を引きつけてセットボタンを押す
MsgEn:
Just as an enemy attacks,
press the assigned button.

MsgJp:
しがみつき中にセットボタンを押した後、

MsgJp: セットボタンを連続して押す
セットボタンを連続して押す

前方に猛ダッシュしつつ鋭い突き攻撃を放つ
突進距離に応じて威力が上昇する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で最大移動距離が延長／
突進距離最長時に敵のガード状態を崩す</COL>
MsgEn:
Rushes at the target and visits a powerful blow
upon them. Damage increases the further you dash.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases maximum rush distance.
Breaks enemy guard when rushing at maximum range.</COL>

MsgJp:
足元から直上へ鋭く斬り上げ、
軽量の敵を上空へ打ち上げる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で速度上昇／攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Traces a grand skyward arc with the blade,
sending lightweight foes into the air.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases attack speed and number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
盾による打撃特化の連続攻撃を繰り出す。敵を怯ませ
やすく、ボタンの連打で攻撃回数が増加する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６でモーション変化／
最大攻撃回数増加（３→５）</COL>
MsgEn:
Unleashes a barrage of strikes using the shield.
Easily staggers enemy. Can be used continously.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Motion changes.
Increases number of hits (3→5).</COL>

MsgJp:
頭上に連続斬りを繰り出す
ボタンの連打で攻撃回数が増加する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で速度上昇／
最大攻撃回数増加（３→５）</COL>
MsgEn:
Looses a flurry of skyward slashes well-suited
to bringing flying foes to the ground.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases attack speed.
Increases maximum number of continous strikes (3→5).</COL>

MsgJp:
後方に身を逸らし、すぐさま間合いを詰めて斬り払う
敵の攻撃を回避しつつ繰り出せば威力が上昇する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で受付時間延長／
回避成功時、攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Ducks backward afore charging in to deliver a slashing blow.
Using it as an evasive maneuver increases its power.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Extends evasion time.
When an attack is evaded, increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
跳躍し、鋭い一撃を放って下方に突き立てる
落下距離により威力が上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Leap forward and stab your sword into the ground.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
盾で前方ガードを固めつつ、連続突きを繰り出す
ボタンの連打で攻撃回数が増加する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で速度上昇／最大攻撃回数増加（５→８）</COL>
MsgEn:
Unleashes a flurry of stabbing attacks while
maintaining the user's guard. Can be used continously.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases attack speed.
Increases maximum number of strikes (5→8).</COL>

MsgJp:
円弧状に剣先を一回転させ、周囲の敵をなぎ払う
のけぞり中にも発動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６でモーション変化／攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Spins with blade extended, drawing a deadly
circle especially effective when surrounded.
Employable while under attack.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Motion changes. Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
盾を構えながら素早く踏み込む
<PADM>左スティック<KEYM>移動キー</KEYM>により特定方向に移動できる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に防御性能の上昇／スタミナ消費減少
LV.６で移動速度上昇／移動方向に左右追加</COL>
MsgEn:
A quick forward lunge while guarding with a shield.
Use the <PADM>left stick<KEYM>move key</KEYM> to dash in a specific direction.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Decreases Stamina cost to block.
LV.6: Able to dash left and right. Increases speed.</COL>

MsgJp:
素早く剣を突き、直後に引き抜く二段攻撃を放つ
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Delivers a quick stab and withdrawal slash
without distancing user and target, allowing
for further blows thereafter.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
攻撃を受け流しつつ剣で斬り抜ける。<PADM>左スティック<KEYM>移動キー</KEYM>により
後方への斬り抜けも可能。攻撃を受ける瞬間の発動で威力上昇
攻撃アクション中であればいつでも発動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大／受付時間延長</COL>
MsgEn:
Hold your shield in wait, deflecting and seamlessly
countering enemy attacks. Use the <PADM>left stick<KEYM>move key</KEYM> to move
forward or back. Perfect blocks deal more damage.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases range. Increases counter duration.</COL>

MsgJp:
高威力の剣舞を広範囲に繰り出す
初段を敵に接触させれば連撃に移行する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６でモーション変化／攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Wide-range, high-power sword dance.
Initial hit connects for full combo.

<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Damage increase LV.6: More hits + new motion</COL>

MsgJp:
しがみついた状態から、力を溜めこみ豪快に切り払う
溜め中は敵の揺さぶりにも耐え、
ボタンの連打で威力が上昇する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加／必要入力回数減少</COL>
MsgEn:
Powerful charged strike while climbing enemies.
Resists being shaken off during charge.
Strength increases with button presses.

<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Damage increase LV.6: More hits, fewer presses needed</COL>

MsgJp:
敵の攻撃の反動を利用し、斬りつけながら跳ね上がる
跳躍後、ボタンの追加入力で派生斬りを発動
攻撃アクション中であればいつでも発動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で跳び上がる高度上昇／派生斬りの攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Utilize an enemy attack to launch yourself, slashing upwards.
After ascending, invert the direction of the 
slash with an additional button press.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP: Increases damage of the skill.
LV.6: Increase altitude of the launch, 
and number of hits of the inverted slash.</COL>

MsgJp:
敵を追従する猛ダッシュの斬りつけ攻撃を放つ
初撃が当たると連続で斬り返しを放つ
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で移動距離が延長／
斬り返し回数増加（１→３）</COL>
MsgEn:
Dashes past the target with blades extended, delivering
slashes that can be followed with further attacks on contact.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases moving distance.
Increases number of further attacks (1→3).</COL>

MsgJp:
一歩踏み込み、敵を上空へ斬り上げる
ボタンの追加入力で追撃する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Steps in with a blade strike that sends
the target aloft. Additional button presses
throw and detonate a store of powder.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
瞬時に身を引き、すぐさま前方に蹴りを放つ
敵の攻撃を回避しつつ繰り出せば威力が上昇する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６でモーション変化／攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Pulls back momentarily afore unleashing a
frontal kick. Using it as an evasive
maneuver increases its power.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Motion changes. Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
シーカーロープを投げて敵を捉え、
手前に引き寄せる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に引き寄せる力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡張/捕捉敵数増加（１→３）</COL>
MsgEn:
Casts out your seeker rope to snare lightweight foes,
pulling them to the ground to incapacitate them.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases the force of the pull.
LV.6: Increase range of the effect.
Increases total enemies affected (1→3).</COL>

MsgJp:
空中からシーカーロープを放って地面にひっかけ、
地上へ急降下攻撃を繰り出す。空中でも発動可能
高所から行うことで威力が上昇し気絶させやすくなる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で周囲の敵をのけぞらせることが可能</COL>
MsgEn:
Hook the ground with your seeker rope, performing
a dive attack towards the ground. A high altitude
will increase the power. Can be activated in the air.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Inflicts stagger on surrounding enemies.</COL>

MsgJp:
前方に飛び蹴りを繰り出し、敵を踏み台にして
上空へ跳び上がる
空中でも発動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にジャンプ力上昇
LV.６で敵のガード状態を崩すことが可能</COL>
MsgEn:
Leaps forward in a flying kick, then uses the
target as a foothold to jump still higher.
Can be activated in the air.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases force of the jump.
LV.6: Breaks enemy guard.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身を通常の構え姿勢に戻し、様々な動作の
スキを消すことができる（連続では行えない）
空中でも発動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に再発禁止時間が短縮
LV.６で拘束中を除きいつでも発動可能</COL>
MsgEn:
Returns the user to a neutral stance, eliminating
openings caused by other actions. Cannot be performed
continously. Can be activated in the air.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Reduces the restriction time between uses.
LV.6: Can be used anytime, except when restrained.</COL>

MsgJp:
地面に火薬を設置し、
遠方から導火線に着火して爆発させる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇／仕込み時間短縮
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加／爆風に風圧追加</COL>
MsgEn:
Places an explosive on the ground to
be detonated from afar.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage. Decreases charge time.
LV.6: Increases number of hits.
Adds wind pressure to the blast.</COL>

MsgJp:
ダガーを高速回転させ、敵を巻き込み斬りつける
<PADM>左スティック<KEYM>移動キー</KEYM>で任意方向に移動できる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で移動距離が延長／攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Rotate your daggers at high speed, slashing nearby
enemies. Use the <PADM>left stick<KEYM>move key</KEYM> to move while rotating.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases movement distance.
Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
シーカーロープを放って敵を捕らえ、反動を利用して
気絶を誘うスライディング攻撃を繰り出す
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で移動距離が延長</COL>
MsgEn:
Grapple the enemy with your seeker rope, staggering
them and sliding through with a sharp attack.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases movement distance.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身の体に炎をまとい触れた敵にダメージを与える
さらに武器の攻撃属性を炎にする
ただし、発動中は自身の体力が徐々に減少する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に炎属性威力の上昇／体力減少速度軽減
LV.６で最大持続時間が延長</COL>
MsgEn:
Sets your body ablaze, inflicting damage to enemies
you touch and adds Fire attribute to your attacks.
However, your health will gradually drain during use.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage. Decreases health drain.
LV.6: Increases duration of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
敵の攻撃を受け流し、瞬時に背後に回り込んで
致命の一撃を与える
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加／受付時間延長／
攻撃アクション中であればいつでも発動可能</COL>
MsgEn:
If used to correctly parry an enemy's attack,
instantly climb behind them, and deliver a lethal blow in response.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases number of hits in the counter.
LV.6: Extends counter window duration and can be activated anytime
during attacks.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身の周囲に火薬を撒き、
ダガーで弾いて爆発を起こす
空中でも発動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Sprinkle gunpowder all around and strike the daggers together,
causing an explosion.
Can be activated even while in the air.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage of the skill.
LV.6: Increases the number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
シーカーロープを放って敵を捕らえ、反動を利用して
激しく斬りこみながら距離を詰める
ボタン追加入力で追撃を繰り出す。空中でも発動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Launch the Seeker Rope to snare your foe, then close
the gap with a fierce slash, using recoil to strike.
Press buttons to unleash follow-ups in succession.
Can also be triggered while mid-air in battle.

<COL ffdc78>Power rises with each LV ↑. Extra hits added at LV.6</COL>

MsgJp:
複数の矢を連続で放ち
敵を大きくのけぞらせる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で矢の発射数増加（３→５）</COL>
MsgEn:
Fire multiple arrows in quick succession.
Staggers large enemies.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases arrows fired (3→5).</COL>

MsgJp:
貫通力のある矢を放つ
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で貫通時のヒット間隔が短縮し
連続ヒットしやすくなる</COL>
MsgEn:
Fires a shot capable of piercing multiple targets.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Shortens the interval between hits,
increasing the likelihood of hitting more times.</COL>

MsgJp:
複数の矢を同時に扇状に放つ
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で矢の発射数増加（３→５）</COL>
MsgEn:
Fires three arrows in a wedge pattern.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases arrows fired (3→5).</COL>

MsgJp:
敵のガードを崩す爆音火薬を巻いた矢を放つ
爆音に巻き込むことで周囲の敵をも怯ませる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に吹き飛ばし力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Fires an arrow that produces a deafening
blare on impact, breaking enemy guard.
Will also launch nearby enemies.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases blow power.
LV.6: Increases the range of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
矢筒内のすべての矢を直上に放ち、
敵の頭上に降らせる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Sends a wall of arrows skyward to
rain down on a broad area.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
着弾時に回転し多段攻撃を加える矢を放つ
特に状態異常矢の使用時に効果的
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Looses a spinning arrow that delivers a
barrage of hits to an area.
Especially effective with status arrows.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases number of hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
装填中のすべての矢に気絶効果のある火薬を
巻きつけ強化する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Applies an explosive stun effect to all
arrows loaded. Increases damage inflicted.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases the range of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
渾身の力で弓を引き、高威力の矢を放つ
溜め満了の瞬間に矢を放つと威力が
大幅に上昇する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で溜め段階拡張（１→２）</COL>
MsgEn:
Draws the bow with all the user's might,
then looses a shot straight ahead.
Power greatly increases if released as
maximum charge is reached.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases total charge stages (1→2).</COL>

MsgJp:
素早く後方に移動する
敵との間合いを素早く離す
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にスタミナ消費減少／発動中の耐久力上昇
LV.６でモーション変化／すり抜け時間延長</COL>
MsgEn:
Quickly dodges backwards, creating distance
between you and your enemies.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Decreases Stamina cost.
Increases Endurance during usage.
LV.6: Motion changes. Increases invulnerability time.</COL>

MsgJp:
火薬を巻きつけた複数の矢を、
渾身の力で空に放ち、敵の頭上に降らせる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で矢の発射数増加（３→５）</COL>
MsgEn:
Coat multiple arrows in gunpowder and send them
skyward to rain down on a broad area.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases arrows fired (3→5).</COL>

MsgJp:
ボタンの連打で射撃回数が増加する
また、射撃回数が増えるにつれ
敵を怯ませやすくなる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃速度上昇</COL>
MsgEn:
Continously shoot multiple arrows as you press
the button. As you shoot more arrows, it becomes
easier to stagger enemies.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases attack speed.</COL>

MsgJp:
絶大な威力の矢を放つ。溜め満了の瞬間に放つと
威力が大幅に上昇し、残り体力が低い敵ほど
効果が高い
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で溜め時間短縮</COL>
MsgEn:
Fires an extremely powerful magick arrow that
gains massive damage boost at full charge.
Exceptionally effective against weakened foes.
<COL ffdc78>LV↑: Attack power ↑ 
LV6: Charge time greatly reduced</COL>

MsgJp:
連鎖的に爆発する火薬を巻きつけた矢を
上空に放つ
射撃時にボタン長押しで起爆高度が上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で爆発回数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Fires arrows wrapped in chained
explosives skyward. Hold button
during shot to increase detonation
altitude.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +Damage. LV6: +explosion count.</COL>

MsgJp:
敵に密着し、複数の矢を番えて渾身の力で放つ
しがみつき状態からでも可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で溜め段階上昇（２→３）
ボタン入力回数減少</COL>
MsgEn:
At close range, nock multiple
arrows and fire with full force. Can be
used even while clinging to foes.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +attack power. 
LV6: Charge levels increase (2→3), fewer inputs.</COL>

MsgEn:

状態異常値が増加
<COL ff7878>獣／有翼／侵食系の敵に与えるダメージ量が増加</COL>
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Increase damage.
Increase debilitation rate.
<COL ff7878>Further increase damage to Beast/Winged/Infected enemies.</COL>

【ＥＸ追加効果】
チャンス攻力と疲労攻力が増加
気絶攻力が増加
<COL ff7878>戦甲を攻撃時、ダメージ量が増加</COL>
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Increase chance attack and exhaust power.
Increase knockout power.
<COL ff7878>Further increase damage against War-Ready enemies.</COL>

MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Increase number of hits on second charge.

溜め時間短縮
起爆時の爆発ダメージ量が増加
溜め２段階で、中央の爆発の攻撃ヒット数が増加
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:

Increase explosion damage.

溜め時間短縮

MsgJp:
自身を中心に物理攻撃力と魔法攻撃力を
一時的に強化する魔法エリアを展開する
フィールドシフトに対応
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に離脱後の効果持続時間延長
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Emits an aura of Attack and Magick power.
Applies a temporary increase to nearby allies.
Can be used with Field Shift.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases duration after leaving the aura.
LV.6: Increases the size of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身を中心に物理防御力と魔法防御力を
一時的に強化する魔法エリアを展開する
フィールドシフトに対応
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に離脱後の効果持続時間延長
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Emits an aura of Attack and Magick defense.
Applies a temporary increase to nearby allies.
Can be used with Field Shift.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases duration after leaving the aura.
LV.6: Increases the size of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
魔力を溜めた後、杖を振って追尾性能を持つ
聖属性の魔法球を複数放つ
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で魔法球増加（３→５）</COL>
MsgEn:
After charging, launch tracking projectiles.
Fires magick spheres of Holy attribute.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases number of magick spheres (3→5).</COL>

MsgJp:
自身を中心に高速に旋回する魔球を生成
受けた攻撃を魔球の数だけ無効化する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に持続時間延長
LV.６で魔球数増加（３→５）</COL>
MsgEn:
Creates magick spheres that rapidly
orbit around you. Nullifies one incoming
attack per sphere. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑:Longer duration. LV6: +spheres(3→5).</COL>

MsgJp:
急速に体力を回復させる魔法エリアを発現させる
（最大回復量は治癒上限値）（対不死には攻撃）
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に設置持続時間が延長
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Creates a healing zone that rapidly restores HP.
(Only recovers gray health) (Damages undead).
<COL ffdc78>Each level extends duration. 
LV6 expands area size.</COL>

MsgJp:
一部の状態異常を瞬時に治療する魔法エリアを
発現させる（対不死には攻撃）
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に設置持続時間が延長
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Creates a magick area that instantly
cures debilitations.
(Inflicts damage to undead)
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases duration of the effect.
LV.6: Increases the size of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
魔力を溜めた後、広範囲に向けて
聖属性の強い光を放射する魔球を展開する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
After charging, fire a magick sphere that emits
an intense light of the Holy attribute in a wide area.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases the range of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身の体に魔力を溜め込み、体力が尽きると同時に
大爆発を起こし、周囲の敵に大ダメージを与える
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に発動中のスタミナ消費減少
LV.６で攻撃威力の上昇／攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Channels magick into your body - when HP
reaches zero, triggers catastrophic blast
that ravages nearby foes. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Reduces stamina cost. LV6: +power/+Range.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身を中心に、耐久力を
一時的に強化する魔法エリアを展開する
フィールドシフトに対応
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に離脱後の効果持続時間延長
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Emits an aura of Endurance.
Applies a temporary increase to nearby allies.
Can be used with Field Shift.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases duration after leaving the aura.
LV.6: Increases the size of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
急速にスタミナを回復させる魔法エリアを
発現させる（対不死には攻撃）
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に設置持続時間が延長
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Creates a magick area that rapidly regenerates Stamina.
(Inflicts damage to undead)
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases duration of the effect.
LV.6: Increases the size of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身を中心に聖属性の巨大な魔法エリアを展開し
侵入してきた敵に攻撃を与える
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Creates a wide magick area of the Holy attribute
centered on yourself, dealing damage to enemies.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases damage.
LV.6: Increases the range of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
精神を集中し、自身を中心に味方の技発動時間を
大幅に短縮する祈りを捧げる
ゲージが表示される全ての溜め行動、詠唱が対象
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に展開中のスタミナ消費減少
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Focus a prayer on nearby allies, hastening the
charging of all their skills that display a charge gauge.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Decreases stamina consumption of the skill.
LV.6: Increases the range of effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身を中心に、生命治癒力を
一時的に上昇させる魔法エリアを展開する
フィールドシフトに対応
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に離脱後の効果持続時間延長
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Deploys a magick aura that temporarily
boosts life recovery around you.
Works with Field Shift. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Lasts longer after cancelling. 
LV6: Area size increases.</COL>

MsgJp:
自身がブラストビットで放った魔法球と
同数の魔法球を放つ砲台を一定時間生成する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に魔法砲台の出現時間延長
LV.６で魔法球の威力上昇／魔法砲台増加（１→２）</COL>
MsgEn:
Creates a turret that fires 
additional shots when hit by Blast Bit.
Lasts for limited time. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑:Longer duration.
LV6: +Orb power/+Turrets (1→2).</COL>

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
魔法エリア内にいる味方の
治癒上限値を徐々に回復する
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Gradually recover the healable limit of allies within the area.

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
敵にダメージを与えた時、体力が回復する効果を付与
離脱後の効果時間大幅延長
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Recover health when attacking enemies.

MsgJp:
大盾に一定時間、敵の攻撃を防いだ瞬間に
衝撃波を放つ効果を付与する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に効果持続時間延長
LV.６で攻撃威力の上昇</COL>
MsgEn:
For a period of time, when an attack is blocked,
a shockwave will be emitted.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases duration of the effect.
LV.6: Increases damage.</COL>

MsgJp:
ロッドの放射光を敵に照らしつづけることで
敵に遅延の状態異常値を蓄積させる
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して技性能上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に遅延の異常値上昇
LV.６で照射範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Continuously shine rod's radiance on foes
to build Torpor status. When force gauge ↑1,
consumes to enhance effect. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +Torpor buildup. LV6: +Beam width.</COL>

MsgJp:
ロッドの放射光を敵に照らしつづけることで
敵に睡眠の状態異常値を蓄積させる
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して技性能上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に睡眠の異常値上昇
LV.６で照射範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Continuously shine rod's radiance on foes
to build Sleep status. When force gauge ↑1,
consumes to enhance effect. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +Sleep buildup. LV6: +Beam width.</COL>

MsgJp:
大盾を構え前方に突進し、進行線上の敵を吹き飛ばす
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して技性能上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で移動距離上昇／ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Raises greatshield and charges forward,
knocking back enemies in path. When force
gauge ↑1, consumes to boost attack.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +Damage. 
LV6: Longer move distance / more hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
属性ダメージと異常値の軽減効果を味方に付与する
（ロッドに付与した炎・氷・雷・聖・闇のいずれか）
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して時間大幅延長
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に持続時間延長／軽減値上昇
LV.６で効果範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Provides allies with elemental damage
and status resistance (fire, ice, thunder,
holy, dark on your rod). When force gauge ↑ 1,
uses to greatly extend duration.
<COL ffdc78>LV+: Duration+ / Resistance↑. LV6: Range expanded.</COL>

MsgJp:
地を揺らし、広範囲の敵をよろめかせる
大型の敵や一部の強敵には無効
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して詠唱時間短縮
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に詠唱時間短縮
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Shake the earth, staggering enemies in a
wide range. Staggers large enemies and
some formidable foes.
When force gauge ↑ 1, uses to shorten cast time.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Shortens casting time.
LV.6: Increases the range of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
魔法のアンカーを射出し、敵を一定時間拘束する
大型の敵や一部の強敵には、物攻低下・魔攻低下・
物防低下・魔防低下の状態異常値を蓄積させる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に拘束中スタミナ消費減少／状態異常値上昇
LV.６で射程距離延長</COL>
MsgEn:
Fires a magick anchor to restrain foes.
Against large/special enemies: builds
ATK↓/MAG↓/DEF↓/RES↓ status. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑:Less stamina drain/+status buildup. 
LV6: +Range.</COL>

MsgJp:
大盾に広範囲を防御できる魔法の壁を付加する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に効果持続時間延長
LV.６で防御範囲が全方位化</COL>
MsgEn:
Create walls of magick that increase the range
of your shield's ability to block.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Increases duration of the effect.
LV.6: Makes the effect protect all of your sides.</COL>

MsgJp:
属性防御の低下異常値を敵に蓄積させる放射光を放つ
（ロッドに付与した炎・氷・雷・聖・闇のいずれか）
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して技性能上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に選択中属性の異常値上昇
LV.６で照射範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Emits light that builds elemental defense down 
status (fire/ice/thunder/holy/dark based on rod). 
At ↑1 force gauge: consumes to boost effect. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +Element potency. LV6: +Range.</COL>

MsgJp:
大盾で敵の攻撃を弾き返し、敵に気絶の
状態異常値を蓄積させる衝撃を与える
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して技性能上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で受付時間延長</COL>
MsgEn:
Parries attacks with greatshield, dealing
impact that builds Stun status. At ↑1 force
gauge, consumes to enhance. <COL ffdc78>
LV ↑: +Damage. LV6: +Parry window.</COL>

MsgJp:
法力で守護された空間を発現し、
空間内にいる味方へのダメージを無効化する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に詠唱時間短縮
LV.６で展開エリアのサイズ拡張</COL>
MsgEn:
Guard an area around you,
nullifying damage for all allies nearby.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Shortens casting time.
LV.6: Increases the size of the effect.</COL>

MsgJp:
魔法のアンカーを射出し、捕らえた敵から攻力を
吸収することでフォースゲージを溜める
ヒット中、<PADM>左スティック<KEYM>移動キー</KEYM>で任意方向へ移動可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にヒット中のスタミナ消費減少
LV.６で射程距離延長</COL>
MsgEn:
Fire a magickal anchor towards a foe, and gradually
fill the force gauge and aggression meter if it hits.
While the anchor is active, you can move in any direction
with <PADM>the left stick.<KEYM>the movement keys.</KEYM>
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: Decreases stamina consumption for each additional
hit while the anchor is active.
LV.6: Increases range of the skill.</COL>

MsgJp:
ロッドの放射光を敵に照らしつづけることで
敵に石化の状態異常値を蓄積させる
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して技性能上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に石化の異常値上昇
LV.６で照射範囲拡大</COL>
MsgEn:
Channel rod's beam to accumulate Petrify
status on enemies. 
At ↑1 force gauge, consumes to enhance effect. 
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +Petrify buildup. LV6: Wider beam radius.</COL>

MsgJp:
周囲の敵を巻きこみながら大盾を振り払う
敵の攻撃を防ぎながら発動で威力が上昇
フォースゲージ１本以上の時、消費して技性能上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で盾ガード値上昇／ヒット数増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Swings greatshield while pulling in nearby
foes. Blocking attacks boosts its power.
At ↑1 force gauge, consumes to enhance.
<COL ffdc78>LV ↑: +Damage. LV6: +Shield guard/+Hits.</COL>

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
岩石を吹き飛ばし、ダメージを与える
<COL ff7878>戦甲を攻撃時、ダメージ量が増加</COL>
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Blow off the rocks from earth and deal damage to enemies.
Increase damage agaisnt War-ready enemies.

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
周囲の敵の注目を素早く集める
エンチャントが付与されている際は
エンチャント属性の状態異常を発生させることも可能
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Attract enemies within the area.
Cause status abnormality of the currently enchanted element
of your weapon.

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
詠唱速度が上昇
ダメージ量が増加
ガードブレイク性能を持つ攻撃もガード可能
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Increase casting speed.
Increase damage.
Possible to block guard-break attacks.

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
発動中は攻力吸収量が増加
敵を引き付けて攻撃を防御するとスタミナが回復
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Increase Force Gauge gained by blocking.
Restore stamina when blocking attacks
and attracting enemies.

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
ダメージ量と気絶攻力が増加
フォースゲージ消費時に威力が上昇／ヒット数増加
<COL ff7878>造魔／魔族／戦甲系の敵に与えるダメージ量が増加</COL>
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Increase damage and knockout power.
Further increase damage and number of hits
when a Force Gauge is consumed.
<COL ff7878> Further increase damage against Construct/Demon/War-Ready type enemies.</COL>

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
スキル発動中ガード状態になる
敵の攻撃を防いだ後、攻撃を敵に接触させる度に
フォースゲージが増加する
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Guard yourself during execution.
After blocking an enemy's attack,
Force Gauge increases with every hit.

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
詠唱時間短縮
展開中に魔法の壁を解放して聖属性の攻撃が可能
敵の攻撃を防ぐと魔法の壁のエネルギーが蓄積し
解放時のダメージ量が増加する
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Reduce charge time.
Can release magick wall and attack surrounding enemies.
Blocking attacks will accumulate the energy of the wall,
increasing damage.

MsgJp:
【ＥＸ追加効果】
展開中、物理防御力／魔法防御力／耐久力が増加
MsgEn:
EX Additional Effects:
Increase Physical/Magick defense and Endurance.
